correctness.rationale: The language is pure inclusion and equality, with neither rank nor constants. In the extension table, intermediate comparable ranks are exactly the gaps of at least two. A lower incomparable witness is a point of the larger flat outside the other one. For an upper incomparable witness when X is strictly below Y, extend X by a point outside Y (or take that point if X is bottom); the one-rank extension cannot contain Y either. When X and Y are incomparable, at most one cover of X contains Y, since two different covers intersect in X, and no cover is contained in Y. For a witness incomparable with both, take a point outside their union or, for the two parallel binary hyperplanes covering the affine space, a transverse line when d is at least two. At rank two this leaves precisely the two-point exception. The back-and-forth recursion uses sets of full atomic extension patterns, not counts. For s<r the masks depend on whether s is zero and whether r-s is at least two, with the other flags determined by r and whether r is top; the dual covers s>r. For incomparable pairs, s is interior, and the possible flags s>=2 and R-s>=2 are (false,true) and (true,false) at R=3, with (true,true) added for R>=4. Thus the truncated rank/corank profile suffices uniformly; all seven stable profiles first coexist at R=6. The rank-three separator sentences are valid because their internal rank/corank tests use only two nested quantifiers, and three incomparable points distinguish the binary line. The minimum count is 1+32+496+1240+620+62+1=2452: dimensions embed in larger dimensions, and the Gaussian binomial coefficients have nonnegative coefficients by their recurrence. Distinct parallel lines, together with a point of one of them, also witness failure of the modular law. The scripts and JSON certificate were inspected, not executed; their bounded checks are corroboration, not the proof over arbitrary fields or unbounded dimensions.
